description: Create Azure Monitor alert rules (Bicep) and health check dashboard (ARM JSON template) for production monitoring.
steps: Step 1 - Create infra/azure/alerts.bicep defining: an action group with email notification (placeholder email alerts@syrabit.ai), and four metric alert rules: (a) HTTP 5xx error rate > 5% over 5min, severity 1; (b) Response time p95 > 3s over 5min, severity 2; (c) Container app restarts > 3 in 10min, severity 1; (d) Memory usage > 80%, severity 2. Use Microsoft.Insights/metricAlerts resource type targeting the container app resource. Reference the container app via a parameter.

Step 2 - Create infra/azure/dashboard.json as an Azure Monitor dashboard ARM template (JSON). Include 5 tiles: (a) Requests per second (line chart), (b) Response latency p50/p95 (line chart), (c) Error rate by status code (bar chart), (d) Container CPU & Memory usage (area chart), (e) Active revisions (table). Use resource ID format: /subscriptions/{sub}/resourceGroups/syrabit-prod/providers/Microsoft.App/containerApps/syrabit-backend
Step 3 - Commit with message 'feat: add Azure Monitor alerts and dashboard configuration'
acceptance_criteria: infra/azure/alerts.bicep exists with 4 alert rules and 1 action group
infra/azure/dashboard.json exists with 5 dashboard tiles in valid JSON format
alerts.bicep defines severity levels correctly (1 for critical, 2 for warning)
dashboard.json references the correct Azure Container Apps resource ID format
verification: grep 'severity' infra/azure/alerts.bicep should show severity values
git log --oneline -1 should show the alerts commit
findings: Both files created and verified. All verification checks passed: 4 metricAlerts found, valid JSON, severity 1 and 2 present.
